newsitem.title: USA: Fla. man imprisoned for $47 mln Medicare fraud.
newsitem.headline: Fla. man imprisoned for $47 mln Medicare fraud.

text.p: A Florida businessman has been sentenced to 10 years in prison without parole for defrauding the Medicare programme out of more than $47 million, federal prosecutors said.
A federal judge in Kansas City sentenced Ben Caroll of Kissimee, Florida, on Monday for his role in the fraud.

"This was one of the largest Medicare fraud schemes in the country," U.S. Attorney Jackie Williams said in a statement late Monday. "Carroll received the maximum sentence, which reflects the seriousness of the crime."

Under the scheme, Carroll supplied adult diapers to nursing home patients in Kansas and Florida and then submitted thousands of claims to Medicare for prosthetic devices. Medicare does not reimburse for adult diapers.
